subject.title: fix(signal): forward reply metadata for durable sends

question: Should this PR land the additive replyToAuthor send-context and queued-delivery field as the durable Signal quote metadata contract now?
rationale: The code path looks correct, but plugin-facing context and persisted queue shape changes are compatibility-sensitive and need explicit maintainer ownership before merge.

options.title: Accept additive durable-reply contract
options.body: Land after maintainer review confirms the optional replyToAuthor context and queued payload field are the intended SDK and recovery shape.

options.title: Hold for broader quote contract
options.body: Pause this narrower PR if maintainers want the broader Signal quote-reply work to define the permanent API shape first.

options.title: Require live Signal smoke
options.body: Ask for a maintainer-run Signal account roundtrip before merge if native visual quote rendering must be proven at device level.

recommendation.title: Accept additive durable-reply contract
recommendation.body: Land after maintainer review confirms the optional replyToAuthor context and queued payload field are the intended SDK and recovery shape.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current-main native Signal quote feature and the PR's durable metadata contract changes.
